screening_decisions.reason: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover trial of systemic inosiplex in alopecia totalis (AA spectrum). Meets RCT design and target condition.
Randomized, placebo-controlled trial of systemic prednisolone pulse therapy in alopecia areata. Meets RCT design and condition.
Multicenter, prospective, randomized, controlled, investigator-blinded trial comparing topical corticosteroid formulations in mild-to-moderate AA. RCT in AA.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled evaluation of topical minoxidil in extensive AA/AT/AU (split-scalp design). RCT in AA spectrum.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled study of topical minoxidil (with switching after 12 weeks). RCT component in extensive AA.
Randomized, double-blind split-scalp trial of DPCP with add-on 5% minoxidil vs vehicle in chronic severe AA. RCT in AA.
Patients with AT/AU nonresponders randomized to topical cyclosporine, PUVA, or IV thymopentin (active-controlled RCT). Within AA spectrum; randomized comparative design.
Small nonrandomized study (n=6) of topical ALA-PDT with intra-patient application; no randomized controlled design.
Randomized trial of topical cyclosporin A vs vehicle in therapy-refractory AA. RCT in AA.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled RCT of systemic imipramine in AA.
Randomized assignment to topical SADBE, systemic IFN-α, or combination in severe recalcitrant AA. RCT in AA.
Double-blind RCT of topical cyclosporin A vs placebo in AA (n=85).
Randomized, double-blind, right–left split-scalp, placebo-controlled trial of clobetasol 0.05% foam in moderate–severe AA. RCT in AA.
Randomized controlled comparison of 2% topical minoxidil vs vehicle after a standardized systemic prednisone taper in AA (includes AT/AU subset). RCT component present.
Program includes a double-blind, placebo-controlled study of topical minoxidil in extensive AA; although mixed with long-term/open elements, there is an RCT component. Conservative include.
Controlled trial on 119 patchy AA patients comparing SADBE, DPCP, minoxidil, and placebo. Randomization not explicit in abstract but likely given design; conservatively include pending full text.
Questionnaire-based study of illness perception; no randomized controlled intervention.
Methodological commentary on when RCTs are unnecessary; not an AA RCT.
Randomized, double-blind, controlled trial of aromatherapy oils vs carrier oil in AA. RCT in AA.
Narrative update/review; not a randomized controlled trial.
Incidence/natural history study; no randomized controlled intervention.
Observational prognostic-factor analysis for DPCP; not randomized.
Patients divided into groups matched for age/sex without stated randomization; comparative but not RCT.
Genetics review; no randomized controlled intervention.
Methodological article on trial quality; not an AA RCT.
